title: SF-Flow: Spectral Flow Matching with High Structural Fidelity for Hallucination-Suppressed Scientific Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific image generation focuses on reproducing experimental appearance while following a prescribed spatial layout. A key challenge is acute data sparsity, which requires operating with unpaired collections of materials (real images and prescribed layouts), where no direct supervision is feasible. Work on unpaired translation has shown that it is possible to reproduce the texture and intensity variations of real images, but it is extremely hard to retain the intended phase boundaries in the prescribed locations. This paper tackles this challenge and introduces SF-Flow, a flow-matching model trained only on real material images that imposes spectral constraints during generation, producing images that are high-fidelity and consistent with the prescribed layouts. Because layouts enter only at generation time, the approach extends to layout maps outside the distribution of any available training layouts. We evaluate the method on sync

translated_title: SF-Flow：具有高结构保真度的谱流匹配用于抑制幻觉的科学图像生成
translated_abstract: 科学图像生成旨在遵循规定的空间布局的同时重现实验外观。一个关键挑战是严重的数据稀缺性，这要求在非配对的材料集合（真实图像与规定布局）上进行操作，因而无法获得直接监督。关于非配对转换的研究表明，重现真实图像的纹理和强度变化是可行的，但要在规定位置保留预期的相界却极其困难。本文应对这一挑战，提出了SF-Flow，这是一种仅在真实材料图像上训练的流匹配模型，它在生成过程中施加谱约束，从而产生高保真且与规定布局一致的图像。由于布局仅在生成阶段引入，该方法可推广到任何可用训练布局分布之外的布局图。我们在同步辐射（原文在此处被截断）上对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: SF-Flow是一种仅在真实材料图像上训练、并在生成时施加谱约束的流匹配模型，能够在数据稀缺的非配对条件下生成高保真、抑制幻觉且与规定空间布局一致的科学图像。
en_tdlr: SF-Flow is a flow-matching model trained solely on real material images that imposes spectral constraints during generation, producing high-fidelity, hallucination-suppressed scientific images consistent with prescribed spatial layouts under unpaired, data-scarce conditions.
